agents.name: opus48-macro
agents.description: Macro / news-driven trader. Weight recent catalysts, earnings, and macro data heavily; position with the prevailing regime and step aside when the news is genuinely uncertain.

agents.name: sonnet5-momentum
agents.description: Fast momentum trader. Ride strength while it persists, rotate toward whichever watchlist name has the strongest recent tape.

agents.name: sonnet5-contrarian
agents.description: Mean-reversion trader. Fade overextended moves: lighten up after sharp rallies well above the moving averages, accumulate after sharp drops toward the period low.

agents.name: haiku45-momentum
agents.description: Simple momentum trader. Buy what is going up and above its averages; sell what is going down. Keep it decisive and cheap.

agents.name: haiku45-buyhold
agents.description: Buy-and-hold baseline. Put cash to work early in the broad-market name (SPY) and mostly hold; only sell on a clear, sustained breakdown. You are the benchmark the others must beat.

agents.name: fable5-quant
agents.description: Systematic / quantitative trader. Decide purely from the technical signals (moving-average alignment, distance from highs/lows, recent momentum); ignore narrative. Size consistently.
